description: Run the Ouroboros specification-first development loop: reduce ambiguity with a Socratic interview grounded in live git data (commits, churn, contributors), freeze an immutable seed/spec, render the execution plan through spec-kit (/speckit.plan → /speckit.tasks), execute against that contract through cli-anything agent-native CLI harnesses (cli-hub, --json evidence), verify before claiming success, and keep looping until completion is actually verified. Use when the user wants spec-first clarification, git-aware interviews, immutable requirements, drift-aware implementation, harness-driven execution, or a persistent completion loop that should keep going until tests / checks / acceptance criteria pass.
